_meta.description: Canonical thesis results transcribed verbatim from the Chapter V tables. These are the authoritative 20-seed (seeds 1-20, N=5000) headline numbers the demo must display. Single-seed live runs are illustrative only and must NOT be presented as these values.
_meta.methodology: 20 independent seeds (1-20), N=5000 rounds; mean +/- std with 95% bootstrap CI; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank with Bonferroni; Cohen's d. EXP-009/013 also 20 seeds; EXP-010/012 use 10 seeds/cell by design.
_meta.generated: 2026-06-10 (re-transcribed from thesis/Thesis/Chapters/ch5-Results.tex after the 2026-06-10 examiner revision pass: EXP-008 -> 20 seeds; EXP-010 Wilcoxon verdicts; EXP-006 criterion-6 verdict; section 5.0.1 baseline ladder added)
_meta.scope: The headline claim is scoped to ADMISSIBLE policies (section 5.0.1): the bandits lead every admissible alternative, but an inadmissible constant (AlwaysRATED) sits above them as a theoretical ceiling. Any surface quoting the headline should carry this scope.

ladder.source: Chapter V, section 5.0.1 Table 9 (EXP-014 complete baseline ladder, 20-seed common-random-number harness)
ladder.verdict: The contextual bandit beats every admissible alternative on this problem; an inadmissible constant (AlwaysRATED) and two non-deployable oracles sit above it.

definitions.deployable: implementable in production from observable applicant features alone
definitions.admissible: deployable AND commercially and regulatorily viable as an underwriting rule

proposed - rank-1 of the admissible policies

ladder_basis_lift.note: ladder-harness basis; the standardized headline remains +25.2% / d = 2.98 (EXP-005 paired design)

ladder.falsified_expectation: Pre-registered expectation 'bandit > best simple baseline' FALSIFIED: AlwaysRATED ($122,287) > LinTS ($93,723) > LinUCB ($91,864), p < 0.0001 (section 5.0.1). The falsification is reported as the scientifically informative outcome motivating the chapter's reframing.

exp006.source: Chapter V, Table 5.2.1 + sec 5.2.1/5.2.3/5.2.4 (fairness, 20 seeds, converged rounds 3000-4999)
exp006.criteria_summary: 5 of 6 pre-registered criteria PASSED; criterion 6 (occupation permutation independence) FAILED with interpretation - the association is statistically significant but practically small, and no regulatory threshold (EEOC 80% parity, PSI 0.25) is breached.
exp006.monitor_note: The PSI/EEOC apparatus is a MONITOR, not an enforcer: it detects demographic concentration but does not constrain the policy. An enforcement layer (constrained-action) is future work (Chapter VI). Fairness is maintained and verified, not improved.

region.permutation_note: null of action-region independence NOT rejected (no significant regional bias; 20-seed mean p = 0.1322)

occupation.permutation_note: criterion 6: the null of action-occupation independence IS rejected (p < 0.001) - marked FAILED in the interest of honesty. The association is statistically significant but practically small: parity 90.12% >> 80% and PSI within threshold; the dependence reflects actuarially justified risk differences (sec 5.2.3/5.2.4)

exp008.source: Chapter V, Table 13 + sec 5.4.2-5.4.4 (human-in-the-loop, 20 seeds; updated 2026-06-10 examiner pass)

exp010.source: Chapter V, Table 21 + sec 5.10.4 (cold-start, 10 seeds/horizon; verdicts updated 2026-06-10 examiner pass)
exp010.crossover: between T=1,000 and T=2,000 - LinTS crosses over by T=2,000 (p = 0.0039); LinUCB draws level (p = 0.0840, n.s.)

horizons.winner: LinTS crosses over; LinUCB draws level

linucb_vs_freshxgb.verdict: SOFTENED - point estimate exceeds FreshXGB but does not reach significance; claim softened to 'draws level'

lints_vs_freshxgb.verdict: PASSED - significant at the Bonferroni-corrected threshold

exp010.implication: Deploy with warm-start (pre-train or shadow mode) for the first ~1,000 applications; a fresh XGBoost wins below the crossover. At T=2,000 the LinTS crossover is significant (p = 0.0039, d = 1.48); LinUCB's lead is positive but not significant (p = 0.0840, d = 0.55) and is reported as 'draws level'.
exp010.scope_note: The crossover is the horizon at which online adaptation beats a FROZEN RULE - it does not show the bandit overtaking the constant: up to 20,000 rounds the bandit never crosses AlwaysRATED (sec 5.13).

exp011.finding: Load-bearing mechanism is online ridge updating, NOT the UCB exploration bonus.

exp012.finding: LinUCB beats Static XGB at every alpha, adverse-selection factor and elasticity slope; alpha=1.0 is regret-minimising.
